chronicle.worldbetween.neris.arrival: Fugitives stepped out of a Nether portal: former slaves of the Hellsmiths. They made camp %s at (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_farm: The first field was ploughed in %s. The former slaves eat bread grown by their own hands.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_lumbe: The axes of the first lumber camp ring out in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_quarr: The first quarry was opened in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mine: The first mine was dug in %s. The Neris are underground again, but by their own will.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_smelt: The first smelter was lit in %s. The fire that once burned them now serves them.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_forge: The first blade was forged in %s. The Hellsmiths taught them well.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_barra: The first barracks stand in %s. The Kingdom of Neris is raising an army.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.famine: Famine in %s. People are dying of hunger.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.tier_1: The camp of %s has grown into a settlement.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.tier_2: %s has been walled and is now a fort.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_1: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Bronze Age.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_2: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Iron Age. Their guards now wear iron.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_3: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Steel Age. Their army is a power everyone must reckon with.
command.worldbetween.status.not_arrived: has not come to this world yet
bossbar.worldbetween.guards: Guards of %s are coming: leave the mine
message.worldbetween.noticed.trespass: The miners have noticed a stranger. Guards of %s are setting out from the shaft. You have about %s min. to leave.
message.worldbetween.noticed.theft: The miners saw you take what isn't yours! Guards of %s are setting out from the shaft. You have about %s min. to leave.
message.worldbetween.noticed.vandalism: You are breaking someone's mine! Guards of %s are coming from the shaft. You have about %s min. to leave.
message.worldbetween.left: You left the mine. The guards of %s return to their post.
message.worldbetween.criminal: You did not leave in time. %s declares you a criminal.
message.worldbetween.theft: This is the property of %s. Taking it is theft.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.criminal: A stranger named %s would not leave the mine of %s and was declared a criminal of the kingdom.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.mine_level_: The miners of %s have opened a second level. Picks ring underground: the kingdom is after gold.
The mines of %s have reached the depths. Down by the lava channels, underground forges are lit.
command.worldbetween.mine.none: There are no faction mines nearby.
command.worldbetween.mine.progress: Dug: %s of %s for today, %s steps in the plan, %s sections
command.worldbetween.mine.map: Level %s, y=%s  [= rails, # timber, C store, F forge, L light, ~ lava, B masonry, . tunnel]
command.worldbetween.mine.stop: Section %s stopped at (%s, %s, %s): something built in the way
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_pastu: The first pasture was fenced at %s. The kingdom has livestock.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_pier: A pier was built at %s. The Neris go out on the water to fish.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mill: The sails of the first mill turn over %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_baker: A bakery smokes in %s. The smell of bread carries far.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_kitch: A common kitchen opened in %s. Soldiers and workers eat hot meals.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_sawmi: The saws of the first sawmill sing in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mason: The first stonemasons work in %s. The kingdom learns to build in stone.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_charc: A charcoal kiln smokes by %s. The smelters need heat.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_tanne: A tannery works in %s, turning hides into leather for armour.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_weave: Looms clatter in %s. Uniforms are sewn for the soldiers of Neris.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_libra: A library opened in %s. The Neris write down their history, never to lose it again.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_wareh: The first warehouse was built in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_marke: A market opened on the square of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_watch: The first watchtower rises over %s, flying the kingdom's banner.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.raid: Thieves and wolves plundered the stores of %s. Watchmen are needed.
book.worldbetween.chronicle.title: Chronicle of %s

A settlement of %s.
Founded on day %s.

Here is written all that has befallen it.

noble.worldbetween.name: %s %s
chronicle.worldbetween.court.first_king: %s, who led the fugitives out, became the first king of Neris. His throne stands in the camp of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.baron_rise: %s rose to become a baron of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.baron_fall: %s lost the barony: the treasury of %s can no longer keep him.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.baron_death: Baron %s died of old age in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.king_death_: King %s died of old age in %s. The council of barons meets tomorrow.
King %s died of illness in %s. The council of barons meets tomorrow.
King %s was murdered by conspirators in %s. The council of barons meets tomorrow.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.plot_succes: Baron %s plotted against King %s. The threads of the plot lead to %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.plot_failed: The plot of Baron %s against King %s was uncovered. The traitor was executed, and his people in %s fell silent.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.elected: The council of barons elected %s of %s king: %s votes of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.acclaimed: The last of the barons, %s of %s, was proclaimed king.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.regency: The kingdom has neither king nor barons. A council of elders rules.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.drunk: Baron %s feasted beyond measure again. Much went missing from the treasury and granaries of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.deserters: The treasury is empty: %s soldiers left the service unpaid.
command.worldbetween.court.no_king: The throne is empty. The council of barons meets on day %s.
